title: Diadem of Arcane Synergy

sources.title: Synergetic Moments
markers: | summary = '''Synergetic Moments''' is a passive feature that adds damage equal to your spellcasting ability after inflicting a condition.

sources.title: Arcane Synergy
markers: | effects = * Weapon attacks deal additional damage equal to affected entity's [[Spells#Spellcasting_Ability_and_Proficiency|Spell Casting Ability Modifier]].

summary: Inflicting a condition can grant Arcane Synergy for 2 turns. While active, weapon attacks add your spellcasting ability modifier as damage.

fields.Base value: 240 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.
fields.Arcane Synergy: Inflicting a condition can grant Arcane Synergy for 2 turns. Add your spellcasting ability modifier to damage on weapon attack rolls. A spell attack such as Flame Blade does not qualify.
fields.Reported triggers: Hidden technical conditions can also trigger it, including a ranged weapon attack miss, casting Sanctuary near enemies, and revealing an invisible enemy with See Invisibility.

changes: Added reviewed native BG3 gameplay and pinned item and dependency revisions. Verified card mechanics against the cited item or linked rule.
